title: Let a task-sync export through when a key already committed retires with a task a held removal keeps out
outcome: Let a task-sync export through when a key already committed retires with a task a held removal keeps out
acceptance: When the committed memory component already holds a key K that retires with task T, and this host's last import holds another host's removal of T, an export with --include-memories that writes nothing new for K goes through, keeping K as committed and publishing unrelated task changes; a newly captured revision of K is still withheld. A CLI behaviour test proves it.
